title: StarTracker 1.0.10
startrackerNotes: Loadout panel matches combat card layout (weapons + armor only). Combat intel tab removed.
Smuggler routes show live UEX stock column with terminal matching and refresh.
Ship builder favorites strip (like Jump to) with star pins on hull picker.
All tabs show emoji icons and category color dots. MobiGlas-style panel framing.

title: StarTracker 1.0.9
startrackerNotes: Patch notes tab shows full game patch content inline: features, bug fixes, known issues.
Fixed broken RSI links; Wiki mirror link added. Refresh button pulls latest from star-citizen.wiki.

title: StarTracker 1.0.7
startrackerNotes: Refinery: full station list with fees, ore yield reference table, compact calculator layout.
Smuggler routes: row expand fixed, commodity column, buy/sell/stock detail on click.
Trade route row expand fixed. Tab order: Log archive last in Session, Credits to last in Intel.
HUD UI polish retained with cleaner refinery and smuggling panels.

title: StarTracker 1.0.6
startrackerNotes: In-app updates now detect newer builds even when the version number matches.
Terminal trade routes, loadout combat cards, refinery and smuggler overhauls from 1.0.5 follow-up.
Use Check for updates in the footer or the Install update banner when a release is ready.

title: StarTracker 1.0.5
startrackerNotes: Terminal trade routes and smuggler intel: buy/sell terminals, live stock and demand caps, color-coded risk.
Loadout tab: combat-only weapon and armor cards with wiki stats. Food, drinks, and cosmetics hidden.
Refinery calculator overhaul, crafting inline row details, ship builder caching and open sections.
Reputation moved to Session. Tools hub renamed to Credits to. Better item display names from Game.log.

title: StarTracker 1.0.4
startrackerNotes: Intel hub: fleet compare, ship builder with wiki hardpoints, combat stats from the datamine.
Guides: UEX commodities, smuggler routes with live spread, mining sell prices.
Awarded X aUEC HUD lines still missing on many builds; wiki payout estimates fill the gap.
